now.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
now.text: As the Wasp, Hope helps rescue her mother from the Quantum Realm, then turns to dust.

changes.evidence: In Ant-Man and the Wasp, Hope never enters the Quantum Realm: 'Lang and Hope distract Ava while Pym enters the Quantum Realm to retrieve Janet'; Hope fights Burch and Ava in a chase across San Francisco and turns to dust there in the mid-credits scene. She first goes to the Quantum Realm in Quantumania.

now.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
now.text: Hank goes into the Quantum Realm to bring Janet home, then turns to dust in the Snap.

changes.evidence: The record ends with Hank turning to dust, which happens in San Francisco (mid-credits scene: 'Pym, Hope, and Janet send Lang into the Quantum Realm... Before they can retrieve Lang, the other three turn to dust'), after he returns from the Quantum Realm with Janet. Only the Quantum Realm is shown; Janet's and Hope's matching records already list San Francisco.
